title: Attested open-source SAT/SAB reader and semantic-gate readiness
mode: primary-source web and package-artifact research; plan-only update
scope: Find a reproducible open-source SAT/SAB parser candidate for the independent ACIS semantic-evidence gate
Bind the candidate to an exact published artifact, source revision, and macOS ARM64 wheel hash
Separate parser independence, analytic expectations, shared geometry-kernel lineage, and native application qualification
Refine one-time composed-check readiness without changing fast-test cadence or committed-fixture policy
Reconcile the earlier CAD Assistant macOS ARM64 option and recent peer ACIS writer-loss evidence

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project documentation, published package metadata/provenance, and local plan state
method.limitations: Package attestation binds cq-acis 0.3.12 to a source commit and wheel hash but is not runtime evidence. The project labels itself experimental and its geometry conversion uses CadQuery/OpenCascade, a kernel family shared with FreeCAD. No package was installed, no local or external sample was parsed, and no support claim was qualified.

sources.revision: PyPI 0.3.12, published 2026-10-16; Trusted Publishing source commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889
sources.observed: The published wheel has a verified PyPI Trusted Publishing attestation to the named repository commit. The project documents bounded SAT saves and selected SAB/ASM profiles, experimental geometry conversion, raw retention for some unknown records, and errors for unsupported referenced geometry. It is a separate parser implementation from libdxfrw and ezdxf, but not a separate geometry-kernel lineage from FreeCAD.

The corpus documents NIST Engineering Design Models and ezdxf test artifacts with upstream provenance and separate license notices. These files are not already-tracked libdxfrw/LibreCAD fixtures, so the plan excludes copying them into this repository and instead prescribes locally authored scratch geometry.

sources.revision: Official product and release-note pages reviewed 2026-10-18; latest listed CAD Assistant version 1.6.0 dated 2021-10-05
sources.observed: The official page lists macOS ARM64 and ACIS SAT/SAB import via commercial Open Cascade components. It states model export/conversion is disallowed for data imported by those components. The app is therefore an optional visual/import smoke route, not an open-source parser or exportable semantic oracle.

sources.revision: Public issue/PR state and stable ACIS API documentation reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: ACadSharp issue #1195 describes read-side 3DSOLID/REGION objects silently omitted by its DXF writer and links an open change. ezdxf documents flat-polygon ACIS mesh projection rather than a general kernel. These are route/direction-specific peer warnings, not new libdxfrw findings.

assessment.planImpact: Adds a source/artifact-pinned cq-acis 0.3.12 candidate and a one-time SAT 700/SAB 21800 locally-authored analytic probe at the existing composed 3D checkpoint. Separates independent parser, independently specified geometry, shared OCCT kernel, carrier/owner preservation, and native FreeCAD outcome. CAD Assistant remains an optional visual-only route. No new implementation item, dependency, fixture, test, support claim, or required gate is introduced.

implementationReadyChecks: In an isolated environment, verify the cq-acis ARM64 wheel hash and Trusted Publishing attestation to the exact source commit; record Python, CadQuery, OCCT, OS, and architecture versions.
Author locally from scratch two asymmetric bodies as separate entities and write independent dimensions, placement, area, volume, bounds, counts, and tolerance expectations before serialization.

At one composed checkpoint, test exact SAT 700 and SAB 21800 bytes; inventory diagnostics, raw/unknown/reachable records, complete body disposition, conversion refusal behavior, B-rep validity, and analytic metrics.
For carrier transport, verify exact DXF ACDSDATA owner-key joins and DWG AcDs key/index-to-owner joins and payload hashes before passing extracted bytes to cq-acis.
Label cq-acis results as independent parser plus analytic expectation with shared OCCT kernel; do not claim independent-kernel or native FreeCAD qualification.
Do not copy the cq-acis corpus into this repository or add the package to project/CI dependencies; if the optional run is unavailable, record NOT_RUN and continue local work.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL until their named external/platform qualification is actually satisfied.
